Experience unlimited creativity with huge environments, rich customisation, co-operative multiplayer, modding support and more! The only limit is your imagination!

name: Combat Racers
shortDescription: A hectic, fast-paced car combat game for up to four players. Drive your own customized car to outmaneuver and outgun your opponents. Quick reactions are essential as one wrong move can be the difference between winning and becoming a smoking wreck.

name: Ad Exitum
shortDescription: AD EXITUMExperience Ad Exitum, a horror survival jump scare indie game of Since Idea Games, which is developed with Unreal Engine 4

name: Nova Nukers!
shortDescription: Nova Nukers! is a multiplayer battle game for up to 4 players (online and local)! Explode your friends on colourful planets with a large variety of bombastic items!

name: Paintey
shortDescription: Paintey is a freeform do whatever you want painting simulator! You can paint everything from your face to the entire environment.

name: Tatsu
shortDescription: Japanese legend tells of a great battle between two mighty Dragon Lord armies, locked in combat on the peaks of Mount Hotaka, competing to win the hand of the Princess Kushinada, the last and most beautiful of eight sisters.

name: The Average Everyday Adventures of Samantha Browne
shortDescription: An interactive story about a painfully introverted college student who must find a way to make some oatmeal in the communal kitchen of her dorm. One simple task, can you help her complete it?

name: Smell Of Death
shortDescription: Smell of Death is a Horror FPS virtual reality game includes action and horror items. The game consists of two game modes including Story and Survival.In story mode you can explore the manor with teleport.You should find magazines and keys.

name: The Haunting of Billy Classic
shortDescription: It’s Halloween night and your girlfriend is missing! Play as Billy, fighting through the randomly generated halls of an old, haunted mansion. Fight zombies, ghosts, goblins, and more with over 120 unique weapons and more than 610,000 costume combinations!

name: Tiny Knight
shortDescription: Tiny Knight is a single-player adventure platformer set in a fantastical world, where you set out on a hunt for a mysterious figure who destroyed your village.

name: Lost girl`s [diary]
shortDescription: A group of girls are having their vacation, alone. What would a group of girls do on a dark Christmas night? Of course, fortunetelling! Unfortunately for them, their boyfriends are not about to leave them alone and their sudden visit totally ruins their plans for fortune telling, turning it into a scary story contest.

name: Atomic Space Command
shortDescription: Manage your ship, build a fleet, and conquer the galaxy with your friends in Atomic Space Command’s solar arena!

name: Aselia the Eternal -The Spirit of Eternity Sword-
shortDescription: With his sister Kaori held hostage, Yuuto must fight as an Etranger, a warrior of power, and take up the sword to fight alongside the beautiful female Spirits who protect the land from an evil that threatens to consume it.

name: Seinarukana -The Spirit of Eternity Sword 2-
shortDescription: Thrown into another world, Setoki Nozomu must fight to bring his friends home, while at the same time struggling against the ancient god that sleeps inside him. So begins a journey that will shake the very foundation of the universe. The sequel to the visual novel RPG, Aselia the Eternal.

name: Watson's Watch
shortDescription: A story driven game where the player assumes the role of a detective thrust into the middle of a series of disappearances on his relaxing vacation. Not only is the city of Watson’s Watch shrouded in mystery but so is our fearless detective. Unravel the story while dialogue interactions lead to its conclusion

name: Void Raiders
shortDescription: Void Raiders is "radical" top down rogue-lite shmup, with permanent character progression, character centric gameplay and never ending carnage in randomly generated environments.

name: The Stargazers
shortDescription: The Stargazers squadron! Three pilots of the Allied Defense Force Signals, first to arrive in any new frontier, their mission? Venture deep into uncharted space and explore the hell out of it!

name: Battle Islands: Commanders
shortDescription: Take part in major WWII battles in Battle Islands: Commanders, from the sandy dunes of North Africa to the bitter cold of the Eastern Front! Master the art of war against real opponents from around the world and reap the spoils of war.

name: Settled
shortDescription: Made in Construct2, Settled is a story driven game with hints of exploration. As you progress, subtle changes appear. Memories and nightmares act as new areas, although still remaining in the confines of the house. When you reach the end, the conclusion may not be what you expected.

name: Phantom Trigger
shortDescription: Phantom Trigger is a vivid hardcore slasher with elements of an RPG and a roguelike. Your world is made up of sick fantasies, you are a phantom. Accept it or stop your treatment.

name: Asher
shortDescription: A retro inspired, platforming RPG. Set in a young boys world of dreams and nightmares. Level up, master masks each with unique abilities, and take on challenging bosses. Using fast action, skill shots, and responsive player controls, Asher allows for a challenging and enjoyable game play experience.

name: CitiesCorp Concept - Build Everything on Your Own
shortDescription: CitiesCorp Concept: Design buildings, manage economy and cope with traffic.A sandbox city building simulation.

name: Operation KREEP
shortDescription: An extraterrestrial organism threatens deep space exploration missions! Only trained personnel working as a team can eliminate these infestations. But, the corporation financing the space endeavor has a private mail for you: Cold hard cash for the alien alive! Which side will you choose?

name: ecotone
shortDescription: You are not a hero, You will not save the world, you may even not save yourself.

name: Mantis Burn Racing®
shortDescription: The race is on in Mantis Burn Racing, where fast-paced bumper-to-bumper racing combines with intuitive, tactile gameplay and stunning visuals in one of the best-looking and immersive top-down racers around.

name: Happy Critters
shortDescription: You can try but the God of all match 3 games will not let you rest with Happy Critters!!! Happy Critters is not your everyday Match-3 title. It is easy to learn, but quite difficult to master, because of its 120+ levels which range from easy to very difficult.

name: Trawl
shortDescription: Trawl is a first person experiential game of discovery and creativity. First you must figure out how to operate the various parts of the boat, manipulating the wheel, throttle and the net. Then, trawl the sea to recover discover what secrets are hidden in its depths and record your findings on your typewriter.

name: Silver Bullet: Prometheus
shortDescription: Infiltrate the military research lab consipiring with the devil and hunt down the demons! Kali, the legendary "Goddess of Death" in the South America Rovolution. She joined Neverlight, the counter-demon organization, after some kind of incident.

name: Doctor Watson - Treasure Island
shortDescription: Players will experience an exciting adventure as Dr. Watson at fantastic locations. The first part of this new 3D hidden object series takes players to the famous Treasure Island. In this adventure, players solve exciting puzzles and interact with a varied landscape and many locations.

name: Doctor Watson - The Riddle of the Catacombs
shortDescription: Dr. Watson experiences in the new part of the successful "3D Hidden Object" games exciting adventures at amazing destinations. NEW: The Gameplay of the famous Hidden Object Games will be ported to 3rd dimension.

name: Blaster Simulator
shortDescription: Allow your intent to destroy free play and become a blaster! With skill, you reach the required rate of destruction and you will win the fight against your competitors to get new jobs - only the best will get the most explosive contract of all times.

name: Highland Warriors
shortDescription: In the year of our lord 843, the first king of Scotland, Kenneth McAlpin, united the lands of the Picts and Scots to form the Kingdom of Alba. 400 years later Edward I, also known as the "Hammer of the Scots" engulfed the land in a great feud. It was not long before Edward I controlled most of Scotland.

name: New York Taxi Simulator
shortDescription: Start your career as a taxi driver in the city of New York and carry your customers safely and on time to their final destination.

name: New York Bus Simulator
shortDescription: Dense traffic, one way streets and a huge city are waiting for you! Sit down at the steering wheel and carry the residents of New York to their final destination.

name: Rail Cargo Simulator
shortDescription: As the head of a marshalling yard you are aiming, according to the single, specified tasks, at coordinating the goods traffic with the available shunting locomotives and by using the hump yards in the most efficient way.

name: Armed and Gelatinous: Couch Edition
shortDescription: Armed and Gelatinous: Couch Edition pits you against friends and family in fast-paced games of blob warfare in the far reaches of space. Absorb a variety of weapons, trading agility for firepower, dodging waves of bullets and deadly dash attacks!

name: One Last Crane
shortDescription: One Last Crane is a visual novel centered on Yuuki Murakami, a boy who has a brain tumor. After a long year of treatment without any positive results, Yuuki asks for his final wish: to return to his hometown and fulfill his promise to meet again with his childhood friend, Saki Nishimura...

name: Bunny Bounce
shortDescription: Can you help navigate Tomo through the pitfalls of work and maintain his sanity in the face of animal instincts, carnal lusts and girls clad in lingerie in this fun, tongue in cheek ecchi visual novel with multiple endings?

name: Neighborhorde
shortDescription: Neighborhorde is a couch co-op shoot-em-up where you and your team of friends use toys as weapons and game-changing superpowers to try to survive the attacks of evil robots and zombie Abe Lincolns.

name: Skeet: VR Target Shooting
shortDescription: A VR target shooting simulator for the HTC Vive. Use one of three shotguns and shoot clay pigeons and other targets in Virtual Reality. Features Trap, Skeet, and Quickdraw modes.

name: Mindball Play
shortDescription: Mindball Play is a physics based racing game. Roll over the competition in multiplayer or have fun in single player with time trials and campaign chapters. Explore up to 13 tracks and race your way through them with either a keyboard, mouse, gamepad or Tobii Eye Tracker.

name: Glitchrunners
shortDescription: Chaotic, five player mayhem takes over in Glitchrunners – a local multiplayer experience like no other.

name: The Huntsman: Winter's Curse
shortDescription: The Huntsman: Winter’s Curse is a narrative-driven, interactive fantasy fiction game with a card based combat system set in the universe of Snow White and the Huntsman.

name: Grimsfield
shortDescription: Grimsfield is a short point & click story game. You take on the role of a deadbeat beatnik poet who lives in an absurdist market town somewhere in the north of England.

name: Bird of Light
shortDescription: Bird of Light is an action-strategy platformer with a twist. Place bridge tiles to create paths through levels in the sky, then run through avoiding obstacles in your path. Leap over vast chasms, collect loot, and discover new lands on your journey.

name: XLR
shortDescription: XLR is a multiplayer team based arena shooter. Party up into teams (with friends, or just join a random match), select a player class, then deploy to the arena for battle. Or practice your skills against enemies in singleplayer training mode. Choose from different player classes to even the odds.

name: Blink
shortDescription: Blink into a world of after-images, where you can walk on light. Solve puzzles by manipulating lights and blinking between worlds. Explore hand drawn landscapes while uncovering the secrets behind this strange power.

name: Zasa - An AI Story
shortDescription: Zasa is an extraordinary and challenging 3D Puzzle Game. Players are going to roleplay Zasa the Artificial Intelligence to finish the training missions from Dr.Mason by linking nodes in 3-dimensional space.

name: IKEA VR Experience
shortDescription: Explore and interact with an IKEA Kitchen in Virtual Reality! Walk around freely, open drawers and put your vegetable peelings in the waste sorting station. You can even enjoy the visual impact of different material finishes and experience things from a child’s point of view.

name: Paper Train Traffic
shortDescription: Paper Train Traffic is here to test your mind and reflexes with increasingly complex challenges. From single railroads to multi railway nodes, your task is to supervise the ongoing train traffic of many different locations around the World.

name: Lost Cosmonaut
shortDescription: Rejoice comrades! For you have survived the crash landing! Become lost on a randomly generated planet in Lost Cosmonaut, an action platformer with roguelike elements.

name: Regeria Hope Episode 1
shortDescription: As Regeria Hope, clear your clients of their crimes, or watch them hang and amass power and wealth. It's up to you.

name: Dimensional Intersection
shortDescription: Dimensional Intersection is an interactive musical visualizer for virtual reality. Featuring music from artists such as Globular and MONS, it will take you to a new reality through surreal scenes filled with interactive real-time fractals, infinite tunnels and morphing 3D models.

name: Maria the Witch
shortDescription: Zaki&Mia stole all the mails and spread them all over the worlds ! Help Maria to bring them back to their owners !

name: Drift (Over) Drive
shortDescription: In DoD you take the role of a driver passionate about drifting, driving your car around the world on all kinds of environments and weather conditions, while taking on different challenges and avoiding all kinds of obstacles and hazards.

name: LYDIA: SWEET DREAMS
shortDescription: LYDIA: SWEET DREAMS is a fast paced, intense reflex game, which challenges players to survive and defeat waves of enemies in its vibrantly colorful world.

name: Brine
shortDescription: Stranded at an Island, the Vessel is broked, do whatever it takes to survive.

name: Bad Caterpillar
shortDescription: Bad Caterpillars and their swarms of insect hordes are invading. Get to your ship, man the lasers, and save the galaxy from caterpillars, scorpions, spiders, and a slew of other ill-tempered giant killer insects.

name: XCavalypse
shortDescription: Months after a zombie apocalypse, a displaced group of survivors have come to the task to take back the city in an unconventional way, not with machetes and shotguns, but with a fleet of excavators!

name: Blast Brawl 2
shortDescription: Fast-paced combat where any hit means DEATH! Deadly enemies and bosses to test your mettle! Champions with unique abilities and play styles!

name: Spectrubes
shortDescription: A new addictive puzzle game from the creators of Big Journey to Home, inspired both by the eighties and the modern games – we present Spectrubes!

name: RePete
shortDescription: RePete is a pixel art puzzle platformer about time travel and self-cooperation. You play as Pete, a special guy that can loop back in time to help his past self solve problems, collect gems, and reach new heights.

name: Mr Nibbles Forever
shortDescription: Endless runner, platformy goodness wrapped in the cutest package! Everyone's favourite hamsternaut is back! Escape the cage, avoid spiders, collect nibbles and rocket to the moon!

name: Virtual Rogue
shortDescription: Virtual Rogue is a top-down action roguelike shooter set in a computer controlled by a cruel and merciless User. You play as a text document file named “Note” who, after being accidentally created by the User, is thrown into the Recycle Bin.

name: So Long Earth
shortDescription: So Long Earth is an action puzzle platformer designed to tell the story of Dominique Fayar, a french mafia member who found refuge in space after Earth's destruction.

name: Night light
shortDescription: Welcome In the destroyed world of the "Night Light", a polluted world has been changed by toxic bombs. Most of the people in the world have been infected by the Virus B1N3 and are mutated to Zombies. And you're on your own. Search food and other utensils. build to protect a Basic you in front of the Zombies.

name: Mystica: The Ninth Society
shortDescription: Explore unique locations, clear dark dungeons, slay powerful creatures, and uncover a world enriched with a fascinating lore and history. Go alone or party up for a more enjoyable experience. The story is yours to write in this open world, massively multilayer adventure.

name: Last Dream: World Unknown
shortDescription: Last Dream: World Unknown incorporates the best features of classic RPGs: replayability and complete immersion into a vast world, rich with detail.

name: AsteroidsHD
shortDescription: Engage in space-warfare with your friends and foes! Dodge and destroy asteroids while trying to stay alive in multiplayer! Replay value is endless with massive combinations of in-game ship upgrades, modifications, and customization. Destroy Asteroids and Aliens to gain the edge!

name: Logic Missile
shortDescription: Logic Missile is an action puzzle based platformer where you and the missile must reach the central core. Launch the missile and setup the level properly so that you and the missile can exit the level. This game is extremely hard keep that in mind!

name: Bitardia Cards: Memes of 2ch
shortDescription: Card games and entered the world of Bitardia. Anons full of excitement and ready to destroy anyone who will sit down with them at the table!

name: Escape: Close Call
shortDescription: Escape: Close Call is an adrenaline pumping driving game which rewards near crashes with style points, encouraging risk and thrill seeking. Escape enemy vehicles increasing in difficulty while completing missions, maneuvering through the landscape, and earning coins to upgrade your vehicle with weapons.

name: Maneki's Curse
shortDescription: In the realm of mortals, it is Gojun who reigns after killing the former god of war, Maneki. Now Maneki's soul is trapped in the Underworld--a rich labyrinth from which no soul can escape. But the former god of war's soul is unlike any other, and his vengeance has had a millennium to burn.

name: Caravanserail
shortDescription: Caravanserail is an arcade-ish trading game. Buy, set a price, and sell. It sounds simple but it'll take you some skill to set the right price according to the market tendencies...

name: Little Walker
shortDescription: Journey your way high and low, far and wide, just for the heck of it. Meet weirdos along the way. Explode things. Explode them good. It's a super quirky semi-retro platform-adventure.

name: Square's Route
shortDescription: Square’s Route is the addictive new game of path finding and weed whacking.

name: Terror Lab
shortDescription: You have just awoken without knowing who or where you are. You can't remember anything but it is clear you are not alone.

name: Minimal
shortDescription: A minimalist logic puzzle game where every click changes the colors of neighboring tiles. Match the target pattern across 250+ handcrafted levels, then challenge yourself to solve each in as few moves as possible. Simple rules, increasingly tricky puzzles.

name: Origin Of Destiny: Crimson Awakening
shortDescription: Sophie and Mike have been separated by an evil group and must now try and rejoin forces before taking on a great evil. But something more sinister is happening and may change the world forever!

name: Rebirth of Island
shortDescription: Survive, adapt, and research in the New World, with its rules, dwellers, and their laws. Head the colonization of these locations and ensure the independence and security of your population.

name: GEO Master
shortDescription: GEO Master is a 3D geography game. This game has different learning modes. You have the opportunity to explore the globe, you can test your knowledge and then compare your score obtained during timed games on the whole planet or on the continent of your choice ! Learn, remember and enter friendly competitions !

name: Pinball HD Collection
shortDescription: Pinball HD Collection - This game will change your idea of Pinball. Each table - Wild West, The Deep, Jungle Style, Pirates, Red Planet, Snow, Da Vinci, Arcade, Tanks, Halloween and others - are masterpieces. You'll be stunned with the level of realism.

name: Lionessy Story
shortDescription: «Lionessy story» is a visual novel that tells a story of a lion cub living out his carefree days in a lion pride reigning over the great African savannah. But life in the wilderness is never easy, and after a terrible tragedy yanks him out of his pampered lifestyle, the young cub has to face the dangers of the real world where anything...

name: VirZOOM Arcade
shortDescription: VirZOOM Arcade is a collection of virtual reality sports for the VirZOOM bike controller. Your pedaling and leaning propel you through race tracks, battle grounds, and soaring skies. Play online live or against ghost players.

name: Puzzle Box
shortDescription: Puzzle Box is painting with creative gameplay! Create fantastic pixel art images, by dropping your colour paint blocks in the correct place across the levels.

name: Imhotep, Pyramid Builder
shortDescription: Do you like watching others do all the work?Cats do!In this unique game (AVX req'd) you plan, direct and oversee the construction of a Pyramid in Ancient Egypt.Organize agriculture, plan the village, direct the building and watch thousands of workers on screen, in real time.Build it, stone by stone!

name: Infinity Saga
shortDescription: You play as Tetra, a teenage boy living his days out as an college student. Tetra meets Autumn; a girl he first met on a social networking site and has grown fond of. Tetra is invited over to Autumn's house for the first time for a date night. However, the two find out that they are out of Autumn's favorite chips.

name: Infinity Wings - Scout & Grunt
shortDescription: Infinity Wings - Scout & Grunt Take control of your chosen fighter (either Scout or Grunt) in this side scrolling shooter.

name: Semispheres
shortDescription: Semispheres is a meditative parallel puzzle game that places dual realities at the heart of its challenge. Its unique single-player split-screen mechanic challenges your brain by putting you in control of two characters at the same time.

name: Torgar's Quest
shortDescription: Travel into the Deepgold Mine to hunt for shards of the Mastery Crystal in this roguelike dungeon crawl, following the adventures of Torgar Splitbeard.

name: Planet in the Shadows
shortDescription: Inspired by the dungeon crawler genre, this short game blends traditional spelunking with base building mechanics. The player is stranded on a hostile planet, urged to build a base and defend it against the awfully aggressive forces of the hostile environment.

name: Colony 42™
shortDescription: Alone, lost and forgotten. You tread the dusty ruins of a deserted, city-sized Nuclear Bunker in search of freedom...

name: Spells 'n' Stuff
shortDescription: Spells 'n' stuff is a magic arena FPS built exclusively for VR. Battle your opponents with spells fired from your trusty wand that never leaves your side. Propel yourself into battle with your wands flying ability, or POOF yourself around fast with magic potions!

name: About Elise
shortDescription: Dive into this first person puzzle adventure and become Owen Scott to rescue your daughter Elise, who has been kidnapped by the organisation known as Kiminster Labs. By doing it, you will discover the big piece of the puzzle that is About Elise as a whole.

name: I, Hope
shortDescription: I, Hope is a beautiful coming of age adventure story about a young girl named Hope, whose town has been taken over by Cancer.

name: The Divergent Series: Allegiant VR
shortDescription: Venture into the world of The Divergent Series: Allegiant in this immersive 360° 3D VR experience featuring an all-star cast from the feature film

name: Phlyndir
shortDescription: Phlyndir is a hack-and-slash RPG set in the world of Phlyndir. You play as Calheit, an ordinary boy gifted with extra-ordinary talent tasked by the king to help an elite team save the world from an ancient evil.

name: Steno Arcade
shortDescription: Steno Arcade is a suite of arcade games designed to teach and drill steno fundamentals in an immersive, addictive, responsive, and interactive way.

name: The Bottom of the Well
shortDescription: Play as Alice who has just had an unsettingly life-like dream about the end of the world, and is retelling it to her friend. A single play-through might take as little as 20 minutes, but experiencing all the possible paths Alice can take through the ruins of her city will take you many hours.

name: Jesus Christ RPG Trilogy
shortDescription: A Role-Playing Game where you can play as Jesus Christ and the Apostles in turn-based battles

name: Rock Paper Scissors Champion
shortDescription: In this game, you must regain your Rock Paper Scissors Crown by defeating the three members of the Triple R Gang: Rocky, Randy and Ripley. They all have their own unique play styles. When you throw three identical moves in a row you unleash a combo!

name: YEARN Tyrant's Conquest
shortDescription: Take control of tyrants in this party strategy game. Plan, flank and witness the fun chaos that is simultaneous turn based combat!

name: Nanobots
shortDescription: Nanobots is a fast-paced casual game about destroying self-replicating nanotechnology robots. You have to reduce the standing population to zero in order to advance to the next level, as even one overlooked Nanobot can replicate itself and bring you back to square one in a matter of seconds.

name: Istrolid
shortDescription: In Istrolid you design your own unique spaceships from a large number of parts to fit your strategy and play style. With no set units or factions you are free to create a fleet where each ship has its own balanced strengths and weaknesses, from basic fighters and bombers to hulking battleships and speedy destroyers.

name: PataNoir
shortDescription: The Baron's daughter is missing, and you are the man to find her. No problem. With your inexhaustible arsenal of hard-boiled similes, there is nothing you can't handle.

name: Land it Rocket
shortDescription: Take control of a rocket and master the art of landing! Enjoy 28 handcrafted levels, two modes, and full controller support.

name: Meld
shortDescription: Meld is a mind-bending puzzle game featuring 200+ levels and a build-in editor so you can create your own and play levels made by others!

name: Calcu-Late
shortDescription: Calcu-Late is a story about a boy named James that needs to participate in a godly Olympics tournament as a representative for the goddess of mathematics, Seshat. The tournament will grant the participant a wish that they stated before the tournament starts.

name: Stormworm+
shortDescription: Stormworm+ is a Fast-Paced Reflex-Driven Arcade Game backed with colorful visuals and an original soundtrack! Inspired by the arcade games of old, collect, grow and aim for the top spot on the leaderboards!

name: Spunk and Moxie
shortDescription: Help Spunk and Moxie escape in this classic-style platformer with a fresh new twist; one-button input gives the player full control over sliding, jumping, and bouncing through 30 unique levels across 3 industrial themes: The Warehouse, Factory, and Laboratory.

name: Dino Eggs: Rebirth
shortDescription: DINO EGGS: REBIRTH is a celebration and expansion of the best-selling 1983 home computer game DINO EGGS (Apple ][, Commodore 64, IBM) -- in which Time Master Tim travels to prehistoric times to rescue the dinosaurs from extinction.

name: Grid Masters
shortDescription: Fight for victory in a 1v1 or 2v2 grid-based deathmatch in Grid Masters. Represent your favorite faction as one of five characters (with more to come), each with their own unique abilities. Toss massive bombs, rocket punch, or send explosive robot minions to take your enemies down!

name: Serafina's Crown
shortDescription: Serafina’s Crown is a visual novel with elements of fantasy, adventure and romance. You play as Odell Perin, the newly-appointed regent of Darzia as she tries to solve the murder of the queen and a host of other domestic and international crises.

name: Backstreets of the Mind
shortDescription: Sometimes we think that if we could change something from our past, our whole life would turn out differently.

name: Mini's Magic World
shortDescription: Mini's Magic World is an action platformer with a diverse cast of characters and levels to explore. Fight bosses, find hidden treasures, follow the rhythm of music, chase or be chased.

name: SPLIT BULLET
shortDescription: SPLIT BULLET is a game all about 'splitting up' a massive crowd of enemies—yes, those polygons—crawling towards you. Don't let 'em get you and survive as long as you can, by using your instincts and weapons.

name: Commands & Colors: The Great War
shortDescription: The Great War allow players to portray important engagements throughout WWI history. The battles focus on the historical deployment of forces and important terrain features of trench fighting in scale with the game system.

name: Hush Hush - Unlimited Survival Horror
shortDescription: Hush Hush is a scare jumper. You run and something tries to scare you.

name: Rush for gold: California
shortDescription: Feel the legendary 'Gold Fever' in sunny California!

name: Space Ranger ASK
shortDescription: Space Ranger ASK is a classic arcade shoot'em up game, featuring hundreds of levels with asteroid blasting, spacemen rescues, UFO destruction, astroid mining and Boss fights! The game includes a fully featured Mission Editor, so you can create and share your own missions, and play those created by other gamers.

name: Bloody Zombies
shortDescription: Fight across the ruins of London using carefully refined Free-Form Combat, taking down a terrifying variety of mutated zombies with an expanding special move-set. Created for 1-4 players, for online and offline play, Bloody Zombies is also enhanced with HTC Vive and Oculus Rift.

name: Fatal Fight
shortDescription: The legendary “two click” fighting technique returns! Get ready for even more explosive martial action with lavish, detailed graphics, stunning special effects, diverse enemies and environments.

name: Ariel
shortDescription: Intense survival experience based on a Sci-Fi, space terror script. Unravel the story of Ferdinand Ludec as he attempts to escape his fortune. Partially procedural world along with different endings to the story. Hunger, avoiding insanity and extreme weather will only be some of the threats to face.

name: Tenrow
shortDescription: Tenrow is a logic puzzle game. Includes 50 levels.

name: Legend of Moros
shortDescription: Legend of Moros is a retro-style RPG that focuses on the quest of Roland and his friends as they try to return to their homeland. But while they have a straightforward goal, adventures don't often end up that way...

name: Jacob
shortDescription: Jacob: an evidence-based puzzle

name: Daughter of Shadows: An SCP Breach Event
shortDescription: The player assumes the role of a dangerous and powerful girl known as SCP-029. After a facility wide power outage occurs, numerous SCPs breach containment and proceed to wreak havoc throughout the facility. SCP-029 must use her mind-controlling powers to survive and find a way to escape from the facility.

name: ! That Bastard Is Trying To Steal Our Gold !
shortDescription: Steal gold from the Lerpikon's dungeons! Get rich!

name: DAMAGE CONTROL
shortDescription: Control your squad of engineers and maintain your ship, and it's crew, until it reaches it's destination. Careful planning and timing will be required to tackle the dangers of deep space. Only your team stands between your sturdy ship and and certain doom. Take command!

name: Stealth Labyrinth
shortDescription: Stealth Labyrinth is a first-person shooter game based on stealth mechanics. In a sci-fi labyrinth, the player must proceed, room after room, finding the right way until the end, before the time is out and everything explodes and avoiding all guard robot.

name: Insane Decay of Mind: The Labyrinth
shortDescription: Insane Decay of Mind: The Labyrinth is a first person horror game. You play the role of Katherine, a young girl lost in the eerie hallways of a building she believes to be her school.

name: Amigdala
shortDescription: Gherman,a middle-aged man who has abandoned all to find what lies behind the "Philadelphia experiment".11 years after the experiment,Gherman found a document that marked the coordinates of the project's military establishment.Certainly he didn't expect to find so much...

name: Campgrounds: The Endorus Expedition Collector's Edition
shortDescription: Help Addie lead an expedition!

name: Overload Playable Teaser 3.0
shortDescription: A playable demo of the game Overload, a new six-degree-of-freedom shooter from the creators of Descent. Version 3.0 is from April 2018.

name: Aegis of Earth: Protonovus Assault
shortDescription: Aegis of Earth: Protonovus Assault is a frenetic and explosive new spin on action strategy gaming. Plan out and build up your defenses as hordes of hulking monstrosities bombard your heavily fortified city in an attempt to wipe you off the Earth for good!

name: Assault on Arnhem
shortDescription: Assault on Arnhem is an operational level wargame for between one and four players, based on the famous Operation Market Garden campaign in September 1944.

name: Roadworks Simulator
shortDescription: You are responsible for the streets and roads in your city. With so many people in a city, there is always the need for new living space, which has to be opened up with roads.

name: Safety Driving Simulator: Car
shortDescription: Safety Driving Simulator: Car is a driving simulator engaging and enjoyable that teaches the basics of driving immersing the player in a detailed and realistic urban environment.

name: Safety Driving Simulator: Motorbike
shortDescription: Safety Driving Simulator: Motorbike is a driving simulator engaging and enjoyable that teaches the basics of driving immersing the player in a detailed and realistic urban environment.

name: Woeful Woebots
shortDescription: Your robot creations have turned against you! As their master you have to destroy every single one of them before they do something strikingly similar to you! Grab your guns from your super high-tech hips and blast your way through their filthy electronic meat!

name: Polyology
shortDescription: A colourful block pushing puzzle game with unique mechanics, a plethora of lovingly crafted levels and delightful soundtrack.

name: Mind Unleashed
shortDescription: Mind Unleashed is a first person Sci Fi shooter game specifically designed for Virtual Reality. You are a robot that is trying hard to survive in a secret military base, inside a rocky mountain. Rocks and futuristic stuff will surround you in this epic challenge where you'll need to survive as long as possible, fighting hordes of robotic...

name: GraveRun
shortDescription: GraveRun is a hurricane pixel Run’n’Gun, where you can kill zombies! Hundreds of zombies, thouthands of zombies! We have many different zombies - you can kill them all at once or kill most ugly ones first! Choose a suitable gun and upgrade it right in the battle - there's no "enough" for your firepower!

name: Ember Kaboom
shortDescription: Ember's a fox who loves adventure. Run, jump, and ride through 30+ colorful, fast-paced obstacle courses in a quest to get your missing soul back!

name: Wincars Racer
shortDescription: An Arcade Online Racer With A Strategy Twist. Instant racing fun in the vein of arcade classics with modernized mechanics and special skills to use intelligently. No random power-ups mess!

name: Giant Cop: Justice Above All
shortDescription: Giant Missions, Giant Fun in pint sized Micro City.  You are the Giant Cop.  Use your size to your advantage to explore the open world, find hidden interactive objects and tower over the city uncovering a criminal plot that threatens Micro City.

name: Cubikolor
shortDescription: Armed only with your logic and your Kube, move through the 150 levels outwitting the traps in the System, an evil, scheming entity, to confront the machine and pass the test!

name: Khan: Absolute Power
shortDescription: The epic based classic online game Khan takes on where Genghis Khan reached the end of his expedition. The game takes place at small kingdom of Eurasia where Genghis Khan's brutal force was never able to conquer. You will re-visit the history and prepare the battles against the greatest conquer of history.

name: Drawn®: Dark Flight™ Collector's Edition
shortDescription: Help Iris light the beacons!

name: Candlelight
shortDescription: A world cast into darkness… but there is hope. After a mysterious entity extinguishes all the candles in the land, a lone surviving candle sets out on a most important adventure to bring light back to the land.

name: Rocket Shooter
shortDescription: Rocket Shooter - this team game first-person shooter. The main feature is a move with super speed and super jumps!

name: A Fold Apart
shortDescription: A puzzle game that explores the emotional rollercoaster of a long-distance relationship — in a world of folding paper! Flip, fold, unfold and rotate paper puzzles to help a couple navigate the complexities of living apart.

name: Tropical Fish Shop 2
shortDescription: A diverse gameplay combines several genres of “Match 3”, “Hidden object”, “Sim”, and various mini-games.

name: Fenrisulfr Puzzle
shortDescription: Simple puzzle, brisk music, soft illustrations.

name: Meridian: Squad 22
shortDescription: Meridian: Squad 22 is a single-player science-fiction real-time strategy game with a focus on base building and advanced tactics. Every single choice, every tactical decision you make, shapes the outcome of your story.

name: Snakes on an Extradimensional Plane
shortDescription: Abstract HTC Vive game where you help adventurous space mice with tiny little jetpack escape the glowing snakes! Collect powerups for points and compete on the leaderboards!

name: ¡Zombies! : Faulty Towers
shortDescription: ¡Zombies! put you in the middle of the action as you try to escape the unstable zombie world. The only problem is, the zombies are everywhere, they appear to be very hungry and very still. There is a limited amount of time within which the player can escape. The price of admission is Zombie's heads.

name: Brute
shortDescription: Brute is a challenging arcade shooter with a vibrant, minimalist aesthetic. It's a game about planning, timing and discovery featuring an atmospheric soundtrack and sounds made from analog synthesizers.

name: C14 Dating
shortDescription: C-14 Dating is an otome dating sim that combines archaeology, friendships and love.

name: Trucker
shortDescription: Drive big trucks faster than ordinary cars, and be careful, coz you are not alone on the road.

name: War Birds: WW2 Air strike 1942
shortDescription: War Birds is a 2.5D World War 2 air combat game, with impressive 3D warplanes and beautiful 2D environments.

name: Secrets of Deep Earth Shrine
shortDescription: Dig your own path in this quirky strategy platformer. Use traps to defeat monsters, blow apart your environment, and collect treasure!

name: End Of The Mine
shortDescription: You are a miner on a distant planet excavating valuable resources. After a night of relaxing with your fellow miners, you awake to find them gone and the colony you call home deserted. With only your companion Camm-E to help, you must venture into the mines in search of your friends and answers.

name: Nighttime Terror VR: Dessert Defender
shortDescription: Nighttime Terror: Dessert Defender is an expanded version of the award winning VR game. Fight your way through six unique levels and defend your desserts!

name: WizardCraft
shortDescription: WizardCraft is a retro style RTS game featuring a multitude of game modes, including; missions, skirmish and battle modes as well as a fully-fledged editor allowing you to create your own maps.

name: qrth-phyl
shortDescription: Arcade documentary of maze/dot/snake mechanic within changing dimensions, axis locks and the corruption of the system. Collect, grow, avoid your past, find new space, wake up…

name: Return Home
shortDescription: Return Home is an abstract horizontal shooter with dynamic levels and metaphorical explosions. The game is randomised and altered according to how well you play.

name: EEP Train Simulator Mission
shortDescription: Are you ready for a job in the railways industrie?EEP TS Mission is a true innovation. For the first time in the history of EEP, the world's most successful railway simulation , you have the opportunity to take on complex tasks in the railway industrie inmidst realistic scenarios.And there's plenty of work to do.

name: The Secret of Pineview Forest
shortDescription: The Secret of Pineview Forest is a free prequel to Pineview Drive - Rising Storm. Behind the abandoned house on Pineview Drive lies ominous Pineview Forest...

name: The Body VR: Journey Inside a Cell
shortDescription: The Body VR: Journey Inside a Cell is an educational virtual reality experience that takes the user inside the human body.

name: Military Life: Tank Simulator
shortDescription: Have you ever dreamt of riding a tank? Now you have got the chance to do it. The times when this sort of simulation was highly complex and enormous complicated are over. This game differs completely from the others and captivates with its intuitive and easy to learn gameplay.

name: Midvinter
shortDescription: Midvinter is a cozy little point-and-click game, which invites you to explore Swedish folklore using puzzles and riddles as well as compelling music and voice over. In it, you as a player take on the role of gnome - the guardian of the farm - and get to interact with various dark and fantastical creatures.

name: One Clone Left
shortDescription: Team up with friends to fight hordes of zombies and mutants that roam post-apocalyptic earth. Need extra lives and allies to help you fight? Just clone yourself and your weapons! Protect your fabricator to become an unstoppable force, able to take on any mutant in your sights.

name: Spellstone
shortDescription: Spellstone is a fantasy card game with beautiful hand-drawn art and rich lore! Collect hundreds of striking cards to battle through a compelling story and unravel the mystery of the Void.

name: Dawn of the Robot Empire
shortDescription: Witness first hand the Dawn of the Robot Empire. Can you stop the invading robotic forces from another galaxy? Blast your way to victory in this retro sci-fi shooter. You'll need fast reflexes and an accurate aim to win.

name: Party Saboteurs: After Party
shortDescription: Party Saboteurs is a local multiplayer espionage party game for up to four players. Each player controls a spy who is trying to blend in an exclusive cocktail party to complete the missions. The catch? At the same time, they are all controlling snipers trying to identify and eliminate each other’s spies.

name: Ian's Eyes
shortDescription: First days at school are usually tough, but they can be even tougher if you’re helping a blind 8-year-old boy named Ian who doesn't know the terrifying dangers that lurk around in every hallway. You play as North, Ian’s lifelong canine companion. Can you help him escape alive?

name: Damsel
shortDescription: Cause distress in this challenging fast-paced action platformer. Experience a dark cartoon world come to life as frenetic gameplay meets comic book visuals and storytelling. Dash through beautiful arenas vanquishing vampires, rescuing hostages, disarming bombs, hacking servers and much more.

name: Rising Islands
shortDescription: Rising Islands is an adventure game where you’ll have to combine fast-paced action with quick thinking. Jump, shift, grind, dash and wallrun through a fantastic world that is fraying at the edges. New challenges await around every corner.

name: The Cubicle.
shortDescription: The Cubicle is a short VR experience about your regular everyday job in an office, or is it?

name: The Rebel
shortDescription: The Rebel is all about having fun and enjoying nice graphics.

name: Realities
shortDescription: Explore what was out of reach before - travel to mesmerizing real world places and discover their stories!

name: Cube Blast Match
shortDescription: A casual color blast puzzler with a 3D twist - solve increasingly complex 3D match puzzles. There are also some aliens and explosions involved.

name: Laser Disco Defenders
shortDescription: A self-inflicted bullet hell that combines retro sci-fi with the sounds and sights of the disco era

name: Insane
shortDescription: !nsane is a nod to the cult game "Logical" from the good old Amiga days. It's all about balls and twist locks. You have to arrange the balls in the right order to pick the lock. What sounds simple enough quickly turns out to be a uniquely tricky game.

name: The Fifth Expedition
shortDescription: Info: The game is not in active development anymoreGuide your team of explorers into the treacherous depths of an ancient machine.On a mission to restore the old mechanisms to life and to save your people on the surface, who rely on the age-old construct for food and shelter.

name: Powargrid
shortDescription: Turn-based strategy that truly is easy to learn and hard to master. Try the demo and see for yourself!

name: BrambleLash
shortDescription: BrambleLash is a spritely local multiplayer co-opetition with team swapping action. Enchanted sprites tether together to defeat slimey hordes, whilst plotting the demise of their teammates to get ahead. Connect, co-operate or betray to win!

name: Vairon's Wrath
shortDescription: Set out on a quest for revenge as Vairon, a young fearless warrior. Visit unique villages and memorable characters that will help or hinder Vairon on his journey. Experience an old school style adventure with varied gameplay where you will fight monsters, solve puzzles, and much more !

name: Vaccine War
shortDescription: “Vaccine War” is an action adventure game with exploration features. It is set in the tense Europe from the thirties, with the Spanish Civil War (and some fiction stories) as background. Aesthetically, the game combines the pixelart retro style with a 3D environment.

name: Dark Parables: The Little Mermaid and the Purple Tide Collector's Edition
shortDescription: Beware of the purple tide!

name: Hacked
shortDescription: Hacked brings a breath of fresh air to the classical puzzle styled game play. Packed with new features and game modes, this game will give you a new experience of an old classic.

name: One Man Is Not No Man
shortDescription: Do you want to fight with a sword? Do you want to feel like a hero? "One Man Is Not No Man" project will quench that desire! You will defend the castle from the army of enemies on your own!

name: Marble Void
shortDescription: 3D Platformer inspired by the 80's. Pilot your Marble through skill based obstacles to complete stages and earn orbs! Will you compete for the fastest time or explore the void in order to collect all orbs?

name: Rogue Contracts: Syndicate
shortDescription: Be Stealthy. Be Fast. Be Tactical. Be Lethal.Enter a dark, dystopic world of advanced organized crime, and prepare to take on a highly militarized and dangerously ambitious syndicate.

name: prog.1
shortDescription: Play as an anthropomorphic computer virus in prog.1, a thrilling 2D puzzle platformer set in a sci-fi world where scientists work feverishly to build the first fully artificial universe.

name: TableTop Soccer
shortDescription: Online, Single/Multiplayer tactical, simultaneous turn-based soccer strategy game. Play live games or play resumable games over a few days. Level up your team, unlock abilities and dominate the leaderboards. Or just embarrass your friends with your superior skills.

name: Borstal
shortDescription: Survival roguelike novellas with meaningful choices and multiple endings!

name: Spaceman Sparkles 3
shortDescription: Sparkles wrecked a spaceship and got kidnapped by a mysterious Green Star, play as Magic in this new rescue adventure.

name: Forgotten Tales: Day of the Dead
shortDescription: Forgotten Tales - Day of the Dead is an epic solitaire adventure! Help Manuel collect unique items along his journey. Meet friends and foes in the land of the dead. Top your high scores and collect gold for new items. Help Manuel reunite with his lost love Maria in Forgotten Tales - Day of the Dead.

name: Secrets of Magic: The Book of Spells
shortDescription: Dive into a magical world of witches and wizards. Travel through magical lands, relaxing music and help Victoria collect unique items along her journey to become a witch. Learn from the ancient Book of Spells in this engaging Match 3 game.

name: Blasting Agent: Ultimate Edition
shortDescription: Trouble in Antarctica!The Black Hand of Fate, an international Terrorist Group has constructed a secret base within the heart of a Volcano, and have built a massive army of bio-engineered soldiers and genetic monsters to take over the world! You are the only one that can put a stop to their dastardly plans. You are the Blasting Agent!

name: Innoquous 5
shortDescription: Innoquous 5 is a huge puzzle-platformer... with a twist! Hit a gravity arrow or jump into a flipper and you can rotate gravity, opening new paths through each of the huge collection of levels!

name: Quantum Chess
shortDescription: Completely change the strategy of the age old game of chess with quantum physics!

name: Ninja Outbreak
shortDescription: Survive in an off-world research station that has been overrun by a contagion that turns its victims into bloodthirsty Ninja.

name: Black Rose
shortDescription: Equipped with a flashlight, investigate an abandoned funeral home that's said to be haunted. Find out what really happened to the people who once worked there, and hope that this dark, eerie building doesn't become your final resting place.

name: Love is Dead
shortDescription: Being a zombie isn't easy. At least your love is a zombie too. Adventure together around the world and solve puzzles, evade ghosts, eat humans and fight pirates. (Who are also humans, I guess...), all to find your beloved pets.

name: To Ash
shortDescription: A unique RPG where instead of becoming stronger, you get weaker as you go along. Demitri is a hero who already completed his journey. He is already powerful, so combat is complex and strategic from the start! The theme revolves around death and acceptance.

name: Airstrike HD
shortDescription: Your goal is to destroy all buildings on the mission and defeat all Bosses. One combat operation includes 5 levels and 1 boss mission.

name: Mibibli's Quest
shortDescription: Mibibli's Quest is a retro-style surrealistic platformer game. Join Mibibli as it blasts its way through over 20 crazy and eclectic levels! Conquer caves, dance through raves, wander the suburbs, and blow up eggs... travel through time and explore your nightmares along the way!

name: Link
shortDescription: Link is a strategy game with roguelike elements. Take control over group of soldiers trying to survive on the hostile, arctic planet. Can you survive until someone will come for rescue?

name: Nil-Ninjahtic: Ronin
shortDescription: Nil-Ninjahtic: Ronin is a pseudo 8-bit action platformer. While it integrates gameplay mechanics of the previous titles in the series, they are combined in a manner which differentiates itself from its predecessors.

name: XorceD - Sashiro's Laedrum
shortDescription: World-line Laedrum: Play as Sashiro Kobata, a World-Peacemaker (WPM) officer with an incredible dual-wielding pistol skill, in an undercover mission! His WPM-group has found out information about a terrorist group. The information: A highschool student is supposed to be the leader of that terrorist group!

name: The Temporal Invasion
shortDescription: EXPERIENCE this Story-Driven Alternate Reality Game (ARG) that blends Your Real Life with Science Fiction as it explores the Dark Limits of Conspiracy, Alternate History, The Supernatural and Fringe Science.

name: SLG Remix
shortDescription: SLG Remix is an alternate kinetic version of the brand new 16-bit horror visual novel/adventure Mega Drive game Sacred Line Genesis. A surreal, twisted kinetic novel tribute to obscure visual novel / adventure games of 90s.

name: A Tofu Tail
shortDescription: The puzzle game of a man-turned-tofu by a deceptive fox spirit, the Kitsune. ​Explore the surreal realms of the foxes to help Mr. Tofu break his curse!

name: The HinterLands
shortDescription: MULTIPLAYER INDIE SANDBOX! BUILD ANYTHING, FIGHT MOBS, HELP DEVELOPMENT!

name: A Room Beyond
shortDescription: Solve a mysterious criminal case in this dark pixel-style fantasy point and click adventure game inspired by literature, art, games and movies in the genre of victorian horror fiction.

name: Rally Copters
shortDescription: Rally Copters is an intense, physics-driven, helicopter racing game that will push you to the limit! Pilot your way through 27 courses jam-packed with perilous obstacles and deadly corridors. Unlock a variety of helicopters to blaze through new levels and crush your record times. Compete against the world in online leaderboards!

name: Mini Metal
shortDescription: Fight through hundreds of relentless waves of enemies in your very own tank! Mini Metal is a 3D fast paced shooter where you customize and control your own battle tank! Face off in an arena against wave after wave of unique enemies, destroying them with your powerful weapons!

name: Break Through: Artificial Maze
shortDescription: This is a 3D maze adventure puzzle game with a unique story and gameplay elements. Players can choose to control the protagonist by switching the soul freely between three unique characters - human, dog, or Eagle. The human is the basic character, and has a gun he can use to take out enemies.

name: MilitAnt
shortDescription: MilitAnt™ blends old school action with a 2.5D shooter gameplay for an epic platforming experience. Jump to the battlefield for a completely original experience of “Epic-tiny proportions”.

name: LuckCatchers
shortDescription: Massively multiplayer online game in the world of magic and steam. Become a pirate or a trader, a carrier or a manufacturer in this unfriendly world inhabited by dragons.

name: I Am Caligula
shortDescription: Follow the real life events of the late Roman Emperor Caligula and his dear sweet sister Drusilla during his short reign. You will explore Rome and deal with the senate while living the life of an Emperor.

name: Spider Wars
shortDescription: Ever wonder what it would be like to be a spider? How about a spider with high-tech armour and weaponry? Well now is your chance in this epic multiplayer high-speed shooter! Do battle with your fellow spiders or just build a web to hang out.

name: Demon's Crystals
shortDescription: Demon's Crystals is a frenetic twin stick shooter where you guide the Urican demons through countless hazards in order to restore peace to the world. A variety of weapons and power-ups will help you defeat the massive enemy hordes.

name: Button Frenzy
shortDescription: Button Frenzy is a minimalist arcade game about having quick reactions and sharp muscle memory. It's a game that will test your mastery of the gamepad. It's simple enough to pick up and play, but deviously difficult enough to keep you challenged for hours.

name: Piggy Princess
shortDescription: Help Piggy Princess escape from prison! Use physics, water and objects to solve puzzles. Launch Piggy Princess like in Angry Birds games.+ 50 amazing levels. Beautiful graphics.

name: Cyber City 2157: The Visual Novel
shortDescription: Feel the mysterious world of Molds and the City where the sun never sets. Look for clues, make decisions and follow your own path in the Cyber ​​City 2157.

name: Shiny Gauntlet
shortDescription: Chase the Cultist. Reclaim the Shard!

name: RAM BOE
shortDescription: RAM BOE is a casual puzzle game inspired by the classic Sokoban, where you control a fluffy ram called Boe in his quest to defeat the evil Jotun Thrym and free all of his victim's souls.

name: World Of Undead
shortDescription: Fast and Action packed First Person Shooter with Tower Defense Game MechanicsPlay the Campaign cooperative with up to four friends or check out our new and exciting asymmetrical Game Mode "Attack and Defense"

name: Aeternum
shortDescription: Welcome to the premiere school of magic and technology throughout the multiverse, Aeternum Academy! You'll learn to dodge bullets, solve mysteries and make friends in this side-scrolling bullet hell shoot-em-up full of magic teacup cats and corgis piloting spaceships.

name: Mystic Melee
shortDescription: A great evil is threatening the galaxy, and only a team of arcane wizards can stop it. Master imaginative spells in this fast-paced physics platformer. Take your skills to the arena for fierce multiplayer battles.

name: Atriage
shortDescription: Atriage, a turn-based strategy game inspired by Sci-fi space naval battles in 80s Anime where you command a fleet of ten warships against a rival commander. Master four different ship classes, each with their own strengths, weaknesses, and roles in combat in an all-out battle for supremacy.

name: Beach Ball Valley
shortDescription: Beach Ball Valley is a relaxing, playful world, complete with pizza paddles. Roll around in a flock of beach balls, send 'em soaring over the hills, let them rain down on you, or pop them all! Everyone can enjoy VR in Beach Ball Valley.

name: Magic Quest
shortDescription: Magic Quest is a tower defense game with towers, mighty enemies, bosses and heroes with unique abilities.

name: Amaranthine
shortDescription: Amaranthine - is a dynamic horizontal scrolling shooter with elements of procedural generation. Travel through warp to the distant frozen planet that sent a distress signal.

name: Gravity Den
shortDescription: Den is a one-eyed alien who is grounded after the terrible crash of a spaceship. On this planet, one can control the gravity around him to walk in space. Lucky Dan is also able to change the gravity on the ground. Help him to reach the lost ship.

name: Jackpot Poker by PokerStars
shortDescription: Enjoy non-stop casino poker action, from the biggest name in poker, PokerStars. Thanks to Jackpot Poker's fast-paced 3-player Spin & Go poker games, your next turn is not far away. With hundreds of tables and thousands of poker players, you get more excitement, more thrills, more poker!

name: Awakening: The Redleaf Forest Collector's Edition
shortDescription: The final adventure concludes here!

name: Gerty
shortDescription: In fully destructible terrains, carve your own path in a new rogue-lite that focuses on challenging combat. Dive into the deep tunnels of a mining colony on your own, or in local co-op with up to 4 players. Purchase gear, level up your character, and gain powerful perks to eliminate the alien horde.

name: Pertinence
shortDescription: Explore a mind and space-bending labyrinth, overcome challenging obstacles, and discover many strange secrets. Distort the walls around you to reach otherwise inaccessible locations.

name: Domain Defense VR
shortDescription: Domain Defense VR is a stand alone game that has been built from the ground up for virtual reality. This tabletop style tower defense game will have you defending each unique level against waves of enemies and bosses with an arsenal of towers and special abilities.

name: The Battle for Sector 219
shortDescription: The Battle for Sector 219 is an abstract strategy card game where two players field a sci-fi army battling a rival race for control of a world's capital city. The game is easy to learn and quick to play but has a depth of strategy usually found only in games that takes much longer to play.

name: Bazaar
shortDescription: Fly on a magic carpet through the mystical land of Bazaar, collecting exotic trinkets for your journey! Beware dart traps, sea cobras, and hungry crocs that lurk around corners. Vandal monkeys have stolen relics from the guardian of the labyrinth - will you recover them in time or be trapped forever?

name: Deuterium Wars
shortDescription: Deuterium Wars is a rapid 2D shooter. Create your own aircraft and plunge into heated battle with other players. What awaits you: an extensive role-playing system, craft, trading, and much more on a single server for all platforms.

name: Bloody Chronicles - New Cycle of Death Visual Novel
shortDescription: A serial killer is on the loose and only you can stop the Phantom! Story of Koyama Kazuki, a young detective working for the Igrasil. While working on several, seemingly unrelated cases, you find clues pointing to the person who killed your parents. Can you stop this new cycle of death before it's too late?

name: Spell Fighter VR
shortDescription: [Old archival game] An FPP fantasy VR demo made in 2016 to test Vive's motion controllers. Works only with HTC Vive and was never upgraded to work with other VR controllers after they eventually released. It was always a free, hobby project.

name: Don't Die Dateless, Dummy!
shortDescription: Choose your route carefully and win the heart of a special girl or you might end up a level 30 wizard! Will you walk the path of a changed man or will your magical powers be unleashed?

name: Clumsy Runners
shortDescription: Learn how to successfully run while making qua-zillion mistakes. Run through 10 procedurally generated chapters. Die a lot. Buy upgrades. Unlock 5 characters with special abilities. Most importantly: keep your fingers healthy.

name: Edgar
shortDescription: Edgar" is a 2D hardcore platformer game which you'll play as Edgar through challenging levels looking for your missing girlfriend Eve.

name: Pixel Puzzles Junior Jigsaw
shortDescription: Pixel Puzzles Junior, The perfect puzzle game for kids.

name: Project RPG Remastered
shortDescription: You wake up on a dirt road, holding on to your last memory of your family screaming for help in front of you. Now, with all odds against you, you must complete challenging and dangerous quests to gain help from the villagers of Bartrone. How far are you willing to go to find your wife and son?

name: YamaYama
shortDescription: YamaYama is a whacky party game where you fight in all sorts of mini-games on your way to victory. The game utilises the FatSuit mechanic, where characters blow out and push other players. Play it at a party or with your family, anyone can learn!

name: FrightShow Fighter
shortDescription: Unlike any other fighting game before, FrightShow Fighter delivers a creepy-fun experience that will leave you curious as to what else these strange characters can do. If you enjoy something different, THIS is the game for you!

name: Odd||Even
shortDescription: Odd||Even is a math and logic based, integer placement puzzle game.

name: Domain Defense
shortDescription: Domain Defense focuses on what makes Tower Defense Great! Unique towers, distinct enemies, and up to four players in versus or cooperative modes.

name: Nokori
shortDescription: Nokori is a game where you raise a hero then you go explore with said hero.

name: Smash Pixel Racing
shortDescription: Smash Pixel Racing is a 2-4 player local multiplayer game about spaceship racing and smashing your friends into asteroids. Drift and dodge around space junk, take out enemies, collect energy, and pick your moment to boost, shoot or smash your way to victory!

name: Dead Some Day
shortDescription: Dead Some Day is an action-packed survival RPG where your focus is to stay alive in a world filled with zombies.

name: Space Scaven
shortDescription: Space Scaven is a physical puzzle game about an engineer, whose job is to collect black boxes on abandoned space stations.

name: Flag N Frag
shortDescription: Cyber Canada's future lies in ruins after its national sport 'Flag N Frag' becomes sentient; destroying all remaining forms of sports entertainment. With only a handful of Fireteams surviving, they enter the Mega Sport to battle in perhaps the strangest fictional sports game ever conceived.

name: Exception
shortDescription: When an old woman's computer system is taken over by a virus bent on total annihilation, you assume control of an ordinary software program transformed into an elite combat machine. Retake the system and build your character into a formidable instrument of retribution.

name: Gunslinger Trainer
shortDescription: Take aim and become the ultimate wild west hero, as you sharpen your gunslinger skills. Shoot down targets as fast and accurately as possible to see if you have what it takes, to be the ultimate gunslinger.

name: The Orphan Dreams
shortDescription: The Orphan Dreams is a permadeath adventure game combined with RPG elements. Step into the universe of The Orphan, who in his dream finds a letter from his own mother he has never seen before.

name: Slime & Friends
shortDescription: Pew, pew, and pew.

name: Weather Lord: Following the Princess Collector's Edition
shortDescription: The power of the elements is in your hands! Use it to reclaim your kingdom!

name: A dragon girl looks up at the endless sky
shortDescription: "A dragon girl looks up at the endless sky" is English translated version on Steam which is based on 「空を仰ぎて雲たかくPortable」released in 2013 as a console game for PlayStation(R) Portable.

name: Dual Core
shortDescription: A vibrant, futuristic, twin-stick style, co-op, action adventure for 1-4 players. Battle through a world of explosive robotic mayhem - Add a generous helping of sci-fi intrigue, and a dash of RPG ELEMENTS!

name: Gary the Gull
shortDescription: Say hi to Gary! Gary the Gull is an VR Animated Interactive Short Film where you are part of the story! Respond to Gary's questions -- nodding, shaking your head, talking -- and see how your decisions affect how the story plays out.

name: Runes: The Forgotten Path
shortDescription: In Runes you are a renegade wizard fighting for survival in a virtual fantasy world. Use the movement of your hands to cast powerful spells, solve puzzles and fight enemies. Explore rich and detailed worlds in complete VR immersion in this story driven fantasy adventure.

name: OBLITACRATER
shortDescription: Dive into an action-packed shoot 'em up where every drop onto the planet is a high-stakes gamble. Fight through endless waves of increasingly deadly alien monsters while collecting powerful upgrades to aid you in battle. You can escape at any time, but beware — death resets your score to zero!

name: Omen of Sorrow
shortDescription: Omen of Sorrow brings monsters of horror, literature and mythology together for a fighting game experience unlike any other. Inspired by numerous arcade classics but offering its own unique innovations and mature aesthetics, Omen of Sorrow positively bleeds style!

name: Dimensional
shortDescription: A first-person, narrative-driven puzzle game. Dimensional throws you into dangerous chambers to save an alien race. This is not a passive experience. You'll have to feel and act as though you're really there - standing, moving around, manipulating objects and reacting to dangers.

name: Storm VR
shortDescription: Storm is an atmospheric survival game. This is the first, short introduction to a series of episodes of Storm. You wake up in an intense snowstorm. As you look around for ways to get out of the biting cold, to somehow find shelter, your body gets colder, your hands freeze up, and the storm intensifies.

name: Surgeon Simulator VR: Meet The Medic
shortDescription: Surgeon Simulator VR: Meet the Medic – be the Medic and operate on the Heavy in this free and exclusive teaser for the HTC Vive!

name: Defend Your Crypt
shortDescription: Defend Your Crypt is a strategy and puzzle game, in which we will have to avoid to lose our treasure by the tomb thieves. We, as the Pharaoh, can use different traps to defeat those damn ambitious humans who are profaning your tomb.

name: Bigscreen Beta
shortDescription: Bigscreen lets you use your PC desktop in VR. Watch movies with friends in a virtual movie theater. Play your favorite PC video games on a huge screen. Hangout in social VR chat rooms. Participate in weekly 3D Movie Nights, VR LAN parties, live rocket launch events, and more!

name: Stonehenge VR SANDBOX
shortDescription: A profound learning experience enjoyed by thousands of families when it originated as one of the first room scale VR exhibits in a museum. With the new SANDBOX Mode, learning possibilities are expanded for people of all ages with the ability to build, paint and create their own ancient monument.

name: Andromedum
shortDescription: Andromedum is a VR novel with stereoscopic environments and audio narration. HTC Vive motion controllers are required!

name: Hotel Blind
shortDescription: Hotel Blind is a simulator of a blind person in a hotel room. Enter a room and complete five objectives before leaving the room.

name: Audio Arena
shortDescription: Audio Arena is a single player arena game in which the gameplay is generated by music.

name: Sky to Fly: Soulless Leviathan
shortDescription: Sky to Fly: Soulless Leviathan is a sequel to the legendary steampunk action runner. Upon learning of the impending attack on Vetropolis, the main hero has decided to become an Agent, but the corrupt authorities want to stop him.

name: Outrage
shortDescription: Outrage is a short cyberpunk dungeon crawler. You manage a team of vigilantes and must undertake various missions in the city to strengthen your team and your cause in order to bring a powerful enemy to justice.

name: Minigame Party VR
shortDescription: Minigame Party VR is a combination of 4 hilarious and entertaining minigames. Throw basketballs, shoot with laser guns, and slash through targets in order to gain a higher score against your friends!

name: TumbleSeed
shortDescription: TumbleSeed is a deceptively deep roguelike about balancing a seed up a dangerous and ever-changing mountain.

name: Adele: Following the Signs
shortDescription: The year is 2029. It is the end of the world. Take on the role of Mike; who is in the woods with his daughter, fleeing from a wave of zombies. During the escape, Mike falls and loses consciousness. He awakes to find that Adele is nowhere to be found. He'll need to follow the signs.

name: Drusilla Dreams
shortDescription: The lovely Drusilla has overthrown her brother Caligula, and has become the Empress of the Roman Empire! Drusilla Dreams is a short yuri style visual novel about the loving relationship between Drusilla, and her favorite slave Lucca.

name: VReakout
shortDescription: VReakout is a modern re-imagining of the classic brick breaker genre with a virtual reality twist designed for the HTC Vive VR System.

name: SpiritSphere DX
shortDescription: SpiritSphere is a local multiplayer game that draws inspiration from classics like Zelda and Windjammers and mashes it together with the nostalgic feel of playing air hockey at your local arcade.

name: POSTZ: ZOMBIES VR
shortDescription: Get straight to the action with quick access, easy to pick up and hard to master gameplay. Consecutive headshots give an increasingly large bonus point reward. Zombies are moving in from every angle so scan your surroundings to find your next target before it finds you!

name: Infinite Shooter
shortDescription: Infinite Shooter is a top down arcade shooting game, also known as a "Shmup", with the emphasis squarely on the action. With no story in the way of your fun, simply choose an opponent and take them down to earn powerful weapons, upgrades, ships, and power-ups!

name: Space Bit Attack
shortDescription: Space Bit Attack is an entirely new and captivating take on a retro arcade classic that gives you the space pilot experience you’ve always wanted from the cabinet games of yesteryear. Each level of this virtual world features a swarm of aliens poised to attack.

name: Vilmonic
shortDescription: Vilmonic is an artificial life simulator and genetics and evolution sandbox game. Protect and breed unique pixel-art life forms where pixels and color have meaning. Craft tools and buildings and change the environment. Find ancient tech and fend off haywire zombitons. Craft Farm Breed Evolve!

name: VR Baseball
shortDescription: There is no feeling greater than stepping up to the plate, with the crowd cheering, and crushing the pitch deep into left field! Now you can live the experience with VR Baseball, the premier baseball game for Virtual Reality!

name: Gahkthun of the Golden Lightning Steam Edition
shortDescription: Lightning crackles in the sky. A lone man hovers, overlooking The Academia. His name is Nikola Tesla, the one who will set this land right. With one assistant at his side, he shall face the council, overthrow the shadows in control, and rescue the unwitting students.

name: Last Heroes 3
shortDescription: Enjoy another classic 16-bit RPG from Warfare Studios of Vagrant Hearts, Ashes of Immortality and Valiant fame, and embark on a quest with Amelia and Roland as they make new friends, experience dreams, and discover their destiny.

name: GAIN
shortDescription: The job is simple: Dont die! GAIN is an arcade style stealth game with perma-death. Freeze guards, slow time and collect the documents in seven frustrating levels without dying. Classic stealth game with no saves. Once you die, its back to the beginning....

name: Who Must Die
shortDescription: You are replacing a doctor, charged to find who, among the three patients, is the one that is contaminated. To do this, you can use a whole range of experiments to be performed on the sick. You can also ask the guard to do the dirty work for you.

name: Babylon 2055 Pinball
shortDescription: Babylon 2055 Pinball is now available on Steam ! Enjoy the feeling of pinball through hours of gameplay.

name: Zombie Pinball
shortDescription: In Zombie Pinball, you will have great fun by smashing zombies !

name: Wrath of Anna
shortDescription: You've been stranded on Empress Anna's remote planet of Drumgore during the Cross-Planetary War of 2021. How long can you survive?

name: Lines
shortDescription: Lines is an abstract ‘zen’ game experience where form is just as important as function. Place or remove Dots to initiate a colourful race that fills a drawing. The colour that dominates the race wins.

name: Plastic Playground
shortDescription: Plastic PlayGround is a fast paced, team based, LAN multiplayer first-person shooter. In PPG you play as everyones favorite toy only this time you get to run, jump, jetpack, grapple, and fly. The goal is to capture as many control points as you can while eliminating and evading hostile toys from the enemy team.

name: ABE VR
shortDescription: ABE VR is an intense experience that recreates the horrifying story about a misguided robot seeking the unconditional love of humans…at whatever cost.

name: The Slimeking's Tower
shortDescription: The Slimeking's Tower is an action/roguelike game where you have to explore a procedural generated tower, collect over 300 different items and slay over 100 different enemies in five different gamemodes to retrieve your people's moustaches back from the Slimeking.

name: Cursor Challenge
shortDescription: Do you want to test your SKILLS and your REFLEXES? If the answer is YES, this is the right game for you! Cursor Challenge! In this game your cursor will face a variety of increasing difficulties ... until the last mode. The IMPOSSIBLE CURSOR CHALLENGE! Legends say neither the developer of the game won that level.

name: Palinurus
shortDescription: A drifting traveler boards a one-man space shuttle destined for Alpha Centauri. This shuttle is piloted by Budapest, an artificial intelligence program designed to serve humanity. When disaster unexpectedly befalls their ship, the two of them are sent careening through uncharted space.

name: States, Firms, & Households
shortDescription: World's first tool for economic paper dissertations! Economic studio for learning like a graphic or music production suite! Neural behavioural model as opposed to rational model! The large hadron collider of economics! Now a deductible tax credit!

name: Intruder Alert: Ixian Operations
shortDescription: Intruder Alert is an science-fiction RTS having 6 totally different factions. It contains a single-player campaign, local LAN multiplayer, simple single player games and special challenges like Tower Defense.

name: Astral Domine
shortDescription: After crash landing on a mysterious planet, you must explore the ruins of an ancient alien kingdom to retrieve the energy sphere that can restore power to your spaceship. A single player interactive VR adventure designed for the HTC Vive. REQUIRES VIVE HEADSET AND MOTION CONTROLLERS TO PLAY

name: Medieval Battlefields
shortDescription: Medieval Battlefields is an indie turn-based strategy game where your only goal is to win the battlefield. Train your armies, build your castles and improve your war equipment! You can be a knight of the English Crown, a champion of the French Court or a fierce Viking marauder.

name: Wizards:Home
shortDescription: Meet Blue, our young wizard in training. He is on a mission. His mission is to defeat the evil wizard and return our powerful stasis rune dolls to the kingdom. These dolls are important to the inhabitants of Melvar because they hold an inverse amount of magic that; if it happen to fall into the wrong hands.

name: Love in the Glen
shortDescription: “Love in the Glen” is a romantic otome visual novel/dating sim with a fun and charming match 3 minigame. Follow in the steps of Zoe Richardson, an interior designer living and working in Los Angeles’ exclusive and stylish Westside, as she explores the true meaning of love, commitment and passion and how it exists on so many different...

name: Super Cat Herding: Totally Awesome Edition
shortDescription: A wacky physics sandbox game where you herd super-powered kittens, fight aliens, and destroy the world to solve the mystery of the missing catnip!

name: Allods Online
shortDescription: Allods Online is a massively multiplayer online role-playing game, set in the fantasy space opera universe of Sarnaut. It is the fourth opus of the Rage of Mages series which started in the mid-90s, conquering the minds of millions of gamers around the world.

name: Discovr™ Egypt: King Tut's Tomb
shortDescription: Discovr Egypt takes you into the ancient tomb of King Tutankhamun using the HTC Vive, where you can not only learn about some of the rich history surrounding his legacy, but also uncover his treasures.

name: Bowslinger
shortDescription: Ever wanted to shoot an apple off someone’s head? Step into the world of Bowslinger, a VR archery game for the Vive. Grab a bow & arrow and William Tell your way to becoming a master archer. Train your speed and precision with various challenges that would make Robin Hood himself jealous!

name: Battlesloths 2025: The Great Pizza Wars
